binding_assay: Affinity purification and quantified PTN binding to phosphacan; membrane PTPRZ signalling assays.
binding_context: Rat brain-derived protein and cultured-cell studies; cell-resolved P60 CA1-to-C1 binding remains untested.
molecular_form: Ptprz1 encodes transmembrane receptor isoforms and soluble phosphacan. Gene-level RNA and shared peptides do not resolve these forms.
interpretation: CA1 PTN-to-IN C1 PTPRZ1 is a supported ligand-receptor family relationship. Local, diffuse or matrix-associated action is possible; synaptic transmission direction is unresolved.
CA1_compartment: Secreted, extracellular-matrix-associated ligand; no fixed pre/post side
IN_compartment: Cell-surface receptor isoforms and secreted phosphacan; P60 IN C1 isoform and pre/post location unresolved
contact_validation: Predicted P60 population relationship; cell-specific contact untested

binding_assay: Mouse SLIT1-ROBO1 binding assays; subsequent Slit-domain binding studies.
binding_context: Embryonic expression and axon-guidance experiments; subtype-specific mature CA1 action remains unresolved.
molecular_form: Secreted SLIT1 engages a cell-surface ROBO receptor. The mature active ligand domain and heparan-sulfate context matter.
interpretation: Molecular signal is proposed from deep CA1 SLIT1 to IN C6 ROBO1. Axon guidance repulsion does not specify an inhibitory synaptic current or a direction of neurotransmitter release.
CA1_compartment: Secreted extracellular guidance cue; no fixed pre/post side
IN_compartment: Cell surface, including axons/growth cones in guidance studies; P60 C6 compartment unresolved
contact_validation: Predicted P60 population relationship; cell-specific contact untested

binding_assay: Recombinant extracellular-domain binding, mutagenesis and structural analysis.
binding_context: Contactin/PTPRG biochemical studies; cis complexes demonstrated in retinal photoreceptors and trans binding in apposed transfected cells.
molecular_form: CNTN3 is GPI-anchored. PTPRG is a receptor-type phosphatase. Cis and trans interactions are possible.
interpretation: IN C6 CNTN3-to-CA1 PTPRG is a candidate cell-surface recognition/signalling relationship. The two genes do not determine which cell supplies the presynaptic terminal.
CA1_compartment: Cell-surface receptor phosphatase; pre/post assignment unresolved here
IN_compartment: Extracellular face of the neuronal membrane; pre/post assignment unresolved here
contact_validation: Predicted P60 population relationship; cell-specific contact untested

binding_assay: SLIT/ROBO and netrin/DCC pathway crosstalk, receptor-complex/co-immunoprecipitation and genetic guidance studies. Direct SLIT2-DCC extracellular binding was not established in the reviewed evidence.
binding_context: Developing forebrain/spinal guidance models. The historical Stein/Tessier-Lavigne 2001 report was retracted and is excluded as supporting evidence.
molecular_form: DCC is a netrin receptor. ROBO and DCC pathway cooperation does not identify DCC as a direct SLIT2 receptor.
interpretation: Retain this row as an indirect guidance candidate. A direct IN C6 SLIT2-to-deep CA1 DCC ligand-binding arrow is unsupported by the reviewed evidence.
CA1_compartment: Netrin receptor on neuronal membranes/growth cones; mature CA1 pre/post assignment unresolved
contact_validation: Predicted P60 population relationship; cell-specific contact untested

binding_assay: Binding of SLIT C-terminal fragment to PlexinA1; complexes from spinal tissue and functional guidance assays.
binding_context: Developing spinal commissural axons, with later mouse/chicken functional work; mature CA1 synapse localization untested.
molecular_form: SLIT-C binds PLXNA1. SLIT-N instead engages ROBO1/2. Gene-level Slit2 counts do not measure cleavage or SLIT-C abundance.
interpretation: Proposed molecular direction is IN C6 SLIT-C to superficial or deep CA1 PLXNA1. The effect on synaptic excitation/inhibition is unresolved.
CA1_compartment: Cell-surface guidance receptor, including growth cones; pre/post assignment unresolved in P60 CA1
IN_compartment: Secreted SLIT-C fragment required for this binding relationship
contact_validation: Predicted P60 population relationship; cell-specific contact untested
